transcript.zh: 2019年的时候，我改投共和党了，对吧？而且有些人觉得我挺有影响力的，能帮其他拉美裔——用我的话说——“看到光明”，对吧？然后……

transcript.speaker: Willie Castillo
transcript.en: I am a Republican voter, so you know.
transcript.zh: 我就是共和党选民，先跟你说一声。

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: Okay. Okay, and that was the main question. There's news reports all over the place saying that a lot of Hispanics that swung towards the Republican Party and voted for Trump are two years later regretting doing that vote. And that's the question, right?
transcript.zh: 好。行，这正是我想问的核心问题。现在到处都有新闻报道说，很多倒向共和党并投票给Trump的拉美裔，两年后开始后悔当初投了那一票。这就是问题所在，对吧？

transcript.speaker: Willie Castillo
transcript.en: In the past two years, no, I haven't regretted that. I supported him.
transcript.zh: 过去这两年，没有，我没后悔过。我支持他。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Sam is looking at me smiling with his arms open, like, see? Willie is even on board with how Trump is removing immigrants.
transcript.zh: Sam摊开双手，笑着看着我，仿佛在说：你看吧？Willie甚至连Trump驱逐移民的做法都赞成。

transcript.speaker: Willie Castillo
transcript.en: I actually got, no lie, friends that I found out that they were illegal after they got arrested by ICE.
transcript.zh: 说真的，不骗你，我有些朋友就是被移民与海关执法局（ICE）抓了之后，我才知道他们是非法移民。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: In the last two years?
transcript.zh: 就在过去这两年吗？

transcript.speaker: Willie Castillo
transcript.en: Yeah. Those people, they got taken by ICE and they got deported.
transcript.zh: 对。那些人被ICE带走了，然后就被遣返了。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: These were good friends of yours? Even though your own friends have been removed from this country by the Trump administration, you still support the Republican Party?
transcript.zh: 那些都是你的好朋友吗？尽管你自己的朋友都被Trump政府赶出了这个国家，你还是支持共和党？

transcript.speaker: Willie Castillo
transcript.en: Yeah.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Can you explain that? Because I think that might be a hard thing for people to understand.
transcript.zh: 你能解释一下吗？因为我觉得很多人可能很难理解这一点。

transcript.speaker: Willie Castillo
transcript.en: I'll be honest with you. I know a lot of immigrants that came into this country, personally, that don't belong here, not because they're immigrants, because they're criminals. They're criminals.
transcript.zh: 我跟你说实话吧。我个人就认识很多来到这个国家的移民，他们根本不该待在这里，不是因为他们是移民，而是因为他们是罪犯。他们就是罪犯。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Just for the record, the vast majority of immigrants detained and deported by the Trump administration have no criminal record. How about your friends? Have they been...
transcript.zh: 需要说明的是，被Trump政府拘留和遣返的绝大多数移民都没有犯罪记录。那你的朋友们呢？他们有……

transcript.speaker: Willie Castillo
transcript.en: My friends are not criminals. The people I know, they're not criminals. They're good people, they wanted to come here and work. But, no. You came in in a certain way, now you gotta go back.
transcript.zh: 我的朋友不是罪犯。我认识的那些人，他们不是罪犯。他们都是好人，想来这儿干活赚钱。但是，不行。你是用那种方式进来的，现在就得回去。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: So, Willie's still backing the president and his party. That's one point for Sam. Willie's 21-year-old son is quietly listening. He's cutting hair, too. I ask him where he's at. He's like, nah, I didn't vote. And is certain he will not be voting anytime soon. He sends me to AJ, another younger guy who's been listening nearby.
transcript.zh: 所以，Willie依然力挺总统和他的政党。Sam先得一分。Willie 21岁的儿子一直在旁边安静地听着。他也在理发。我问他是什么态度。他说，没，我没投票。而且他很确定自己短期内都不会去投票。他让我去问问AJ，那是旁边另一个一直在听我们说话的年轻人。

transcript.speaker: AJ
transcript.en: I voted Trump. Trump, yeah.
transcript.zh: 我投了Trump。投的Trump，对。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: How do you feel now?
transcript.zh: 你现在感觉怎么样？

transcript.speaker: AJ
transcript.en: Yeah, I'm not really into all that... everything he got going...
transcript.zh: 嗯，我其实不太喜欢他现在搞的那些……他弄出来的那堆事……

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.en: I just know a little bit here and there.
transcript.zh: 我只是零零星星知道一点儿。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Do you regret voting for him? Sam jumps in.
transcript.zh: 你后悔投给他了吗？Sam插话问道。

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: Do you feel like it might have been a mistake voting for him?
transcript.zh: 你觉得投给他可能是个错误吗？

transcript.speaker: Man
transcript.en: The regret is probably from the racistness, like people be saying he's racist, all that. But no, I don't, me personally, I don't regret it, no. Yeah. He knows, he knows what he's doing most of the time.
transcript.zh: 后悔的可能在于种族歧视那方面，就像人们老说他是种族主义者什么的。但我个人不后悔，真的不后悔。嗯，他大多数时候都知道自己在干嘛。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: That's another point for Sam. In the waiting chairs at the front, I meet another guy, black guy. Hang on. Honorary Dominican, according to a barber nearby.
transcript.zh: Sam又拿下一分。在前面的候客椅上，我又遇到一个黑人小哥。等等，按旁边一位理发师的说法，他算是个“荣誉多米尼加人”。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: He's also sticking with Trump. He wishes ICE would go further. Not technically a Hispanic voter, but I'll give Sam the honorary point. Sam's killing it. His prophecies coming true.
transcript.zh: 他也依然支持Trump，甚至希望ICE能采取更强硬的行动。严格来说他不算西语裔选民，但我就给Sam算个“荣誉分”吧。Sam简直太神了，他的预言正在一一应验。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Outside, we run into one more person, Rolando Rolon, an older Puerto Rican guy who was sitting on a pink camp chair in front of the store. He's got a cane, aviators on, lots of jewelry on his hands and neck. He's been voting Republican for a long time. And he also stands by his vote for Trump.
transcript.zh: 走到店外，我们又碰见一个人，名叫Rolando Rolon，是一位上了年纪的波多黎各裔大叔，正坐在店门口一把粉色的折叠露营椅上。他拄着拐杖，戴着飞行员墨镜，手上和脖子上戴满了首饰。他一直投给共和党，而且这次也依然坚定支持Trump。

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: 'Cause that job is a tough job, and the mess that was happened before is not easy to fix in two years.
transcript.zh: 因为那份工作本来就不好干，以前留下的烂摊子，哪能那么容易在两年内收拾好。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: He's gonna vote Republican in the midterms. But with one possible exception.
transcript.zh: 中期选举他还是会投给共和党。不过，可能有一个例外。

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: I understand the governor is Democrat, and I admit it, he's doing a good job.
transcript.zh: 我知道州长是民主党人，但我也承认，他干得确实不错。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Which one?
transcript.zh: 哪位？

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: Shapiro.
transcript.zh: Shapiro。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: The governor. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
transcript.zh: 州长啊。对对对。

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: I gotta be realistic, you know, he's doing a good job.
transcript.zh: 我得实事求是嘛，他干得确实挺好。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Are you gonna vote for Shapiro for governor?
transcript.zh: 那你州长选举会投给Shapiro吗？

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: I'm not sure.
transcript.zh: 说不准。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Sam senses opportunity, like when a lion hears a gazelle step on a branch. His head snaps towards the undecided voter.
transcript.zh: Sam嗅到了机会，就像狮子听见羚羊踩断树枝的声音一样。他猛地转过头，盯住了这位还没拿定主意的选民。

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: ¿Verdad?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: Sí, sí.
transcript.zh: 对，对。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Rolando also perks up. He obviously would rather talk to Sam than me. Sam asks him, what do you know about the Republican candidate for governor, Stacy Garrity?
transcript.zh: Rolando也来了精神，他显然更愿意跟Sam聊，而不是跟我。Sam问他，对共和党州长候选人Stacy Garrity了解多少？

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: ¿Qué tú sabes de Stacy Garrity? ¿Sabes algo de ella?
transcript.zh: 你对Stacy Garrity了解多少？知道她吗？

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: No, es que realmente no ha hecho, o no le han dado la oportunidad para que ella le diga al pueblo cuál es su plan de trabajo.
transcript.zh: 不了解，其实她没怎么露面，或者说别人没给她机会，让她向老百姓讲清楚自己的施政计划。

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: Yo conozco... You speak English. I know Stacy. I can't say that I know her personally. I've done a lot of work with Stacy.
transcript.zh: 我认识……你会说英语吧。我认识Stacy。不能说私交有多深，但我跟她共事过很多次。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Sam pulls up pictures on his phone. He's done private security at some Garrity events. And these are of him and Garrity, videos he's taken behind the scenes with her. Also, pictures of her in uniform. He talks about her military service, her years in Harrisburg as treasurer.
transcript.zh: Sam在手机上翻出照片。他在Garrity的几场活动上做过私人安保。这些是他和Garrity的合影，还有他在幕后拍的视频，以及她穿军装的照片。他聊起她的军旅生涯，还有她在哈里斯堡担任州财政部长那几年的经历。

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: Um, it's somebody that you really need to look into, Stacy Garrity, papi, just la buscas. And look up on the information. She's the one running against Shapiro. They just had a debate. There was several times that the moderators had to say to him after he finished answering, 'Okay, can you answer the question now?' You know what I mean? It's something that you...
transcript.zh: 嗯，Stacy Garrity这人你真得去了解一下，老兄，去搜搜看，查查她的资料。就是她跟Shapiro竞选。他俩刚辩论完，好几次他回答完问题，主持人不得不对他说：“好了，你现在能回答刚才的问题了吗？”你懂我意思吧？这就是那种……

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: He monkey around.
transcript.zh: 他就在那儿耍滑头。

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: Right. You know, you know attorneys, brother, they're good at talking and saying stuff. For me, it's different, especially with her, since I've done protection for her so many times. It's different when you go to a place and you see these candidates talk, obviously they got their, you know, their game face on.
transcript.zh: 没错。你也知道那些律师，老兄，最擅长兜圈子耍嘴皮子了。但对我来说不一样，尤其是对她，因为我给她做过太多次安保了。你去现场听那些候选人演讲，他们肯定都戴着“职业假笑”嘛，那跟私底下完全不一样。

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: It's different when we're in a back room waiting and I'm helping her mom get into, you know, into a chair, or and we're talking. I find her to be a very, very genuine person, someone who really cares. And I believe that she would be the better candidate. That's just my opinion, but it's something you should look into.
transcript.zh: 我们在后台休息室等着的时候，我扶她妈妈坐下，或者跟她聊天，那种感觉是不一样的。我觉得她是个非常、非常真诚的人，是真的关心大家。我相信她会是更好的候选人。这只是我的看法，但你真应该去了解一下。

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: Yeah, I think that...
transcript.zh: 是啊，我觉得……

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: What's he gonna say, faced with that charismatic sell?
transcript.zh: 面对这么有感染力的推销，他能怎么说呢？

transcript.speaker: Rolando Rolon
transcript.en: To be honest to you, I'm not gonna vote for Josh Shapiro after what he tell me.
transcript.zh: 老实跟你说，听完他这么一讲，我不会投给Josh Shapiro了。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: Somehow, millions of dollars in Stacy Garrity ads hadn't reached him. But Sam did. That's one last bonus point for Sam.
transcript.zh: 不知怎么的，Stacy Garrity砸了几百万美元的广告都没打动他，但Sam做到了。这是Sam拿下的最后一份加分。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: That was crazy, right? Did you bring me to Republican headquarters disguised as a barbershop?
transcript.zh: 刚才太疯狂了，对吧？你是不是把我带到了一个伪装成理发店的共和党总部啊？

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: No, brother. What I'm finding is that most of us are still on board. I was a little worried at first, but now I'm not worried. I think we got this.
transcript.zh: 没有啦，老兄。我发现我们大多数人还是支持共和党的。一开始我还有点担心，但现在不担心了。我觉得稳了。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: A lot of people are predicting a blue wave.
transcript.zh: 很多人都在预测会出现“蓝色浪潮”。

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: For real? I haven't heard that. I can show you my Facebook. It's all red, brother. From all the people that I've spoken to, I don't see...
transcript.zh: 真的假的？我可没听说。我可以给你看我的Facebook，全是红的，老兄。就我聊过的所有人来看，我没觉得……

transcript.speaker: Sam Negron
transcript.en: ...blue wave coming. I don't see it. It would shock the hell out of me.
transcript.zh: ……什么蓝色浪潮要来了，我可没看出来。要是真发生了，我绝对会大吃一惊。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: I called the Oracle back just days before the election. He's still predicting a red wave, with a Republican winning his local congressional district and Republicans gaining seats in the House and the Senate.
transcript.zh: 就在大选前几天，我又给这位“先知”打了个电话。他依然预测会出现一场红色浪潮：不仅共和党人会赢下他所在的国会选区，共和党还会在众议院和参议院双双斩获更多席位。

transcript.speaker: Ike Sriskandarajah
transcript.en: For Pennsylvania governor, he says Stacy Garrity will beat Josh Shapiro. All of these predictions are the opposite of what the polls say. On Tuesday, we get to find out if Sam is still the Oracle of Allentown.
transcript.zh: 至于宾夕法尼亚州州长之位，他认为 Stacy Garrity 会击败 Josh Shapiro。所有这些预测都和民调结果恰恰相反。到了周二，我们就能见分晓，看看 Sam 究竟还是不是那个“阿伦敦先知”。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: Ike Sriskandarajah is one of the producers of our show.
transcript.zh: Ike Sriskandarajah 是我们节目的制作人之一。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: Our program was produced today by Lilly Sullivan and edited by David Kestenbaum. The people who put our show together today include Michael Comite, Andrea Lopez-Cruzado, Emmanuel Dzotsi, Chana Joffe-Walt, Adrienne Lilly, Seth Lind, Andrea Marks, Miki Meek, Katherine Raimondo, Stone Nelson, Nadia Reiman, Anthony Roman, Ryan Rumery, Ruby Schwartz, Alisa Shipp, Christopher Swetala, and Diane Wu. Our managing editor is Sara Abdurrahman. Our senior editors, David Kestenbaum and Nancy Updike. Our executive editor is Emmanuel Berry.
transcript.zh: 本期节目由 Lilly Sullivan 制作，David Kestenbaum 担任编辑。今天参与节目制作的工作人员包括：Michael Comite、Andrea Lopez-Cruzado、Emmanuel Dzotsi、Chana Joffe-Walt、Adrienne Lilly、Seth Lind、Andrea Marks、Miki Meek、Katherine Raimondo、Stone Nelson、Nadia Reiman、Anthony Roman、Ryan Rumery、Ruby Schwartz、Alisa Shipp、Christopher Swetala 和 Diane Wu。我们的执行主编是 Sara Abdurrahman，资深编辑是 David Kestenbaum 和 Nancy Updike，总编辑是 Emmanuel Berry。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: This is our very last week with Katherine Raimondo mixing our show. She does such beautiful work that you hear and don't know is hers, but we do. We're gonna miss her.
transcript.zh: 这周是 Katherine Raimondo 最后一次为我们的节目做混音了。她的工作非常出色，你们平时听到的许多精彩之处其实都出自她手，只是你们不知道罢了，但我们心里都清楚。我们会非常想念她的。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: Special thanks today to Victoria Eavis, Chris Moyles, Montana Public Radio, Nathan Heller, Mina Ganesan, Mito Habe-Evans, Constance Van Kley, and Jenna Molster and Julie Rogers at NPR.
transcript.zh: 今天特别鸣谢 Victoria Eavis、Chris Moyles、蒙大拿公共广播电台、Nathan Heller、Mina Ganesan、Mito Habe-Evans、Constance Van Kley，以及 NPR 的 Jenna Molster 和 Julie Rogers。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: Our website, thisamericanlife.org, where you can stream our archive of 900 episodes for absolutely free. This is literally the 900th episode right here. Again, thisamericanlife.org. This American Life is delivered to public radio stations by PRX, the Public Radio Exchange.
transcript.zh: 我们的网站是 thisamericanlife.org，在那里你可以完全免费地在线收听我们全部 900 期往期节目。没错，你现在听到的正是第 900 期。再次提醒，网址是 thisamericanlife.org。This American Life 由公共广播交流中心 PRX 向各公共广播电台传送。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: Quick program note: this is going to be the last time I mention the live show that we did on stage in Los Angeles. In that show, I told stories, these amazing comedians improvised scenes based on the stories. It's super funny. We filmed it. You can watch it for free by signing up for a free trial, This American Life Partners membership. And yes, we are doing this hoping you're going to try it out, see all the bonus episodes and the other stuff you get, and decide to stick around and support the show.
transcript.zh: 最后插播一条节目预告：这大概是我最后一次提到我们在洛杉矶举办的那场舞台现场秀了。在那场演出里，我负责讲故事，一群超棒的喜剧演员则根据我的故事进行即兴表演。现场效果特别搞笑，我们还把它拍了下来。只要注册成为 This American Life Partners 会员并开启免费试用，你就能免费观看这场演出。当然，我们这么做也是希望你能来体验一下，看看里面的加更节目和其他福利，最后决定留下来支持我们。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: But if you don't, if you just watch the live show and then cancel, no hard feelings, we're still friends. Either way, head to thisamericanlife.org/lifepartners, use promo code VIDEO for the free trial. That link is also in the show notes.
transcript.zh: 不过就算你不留下来，只是看完现场秀就取消订阅，我们也完全不会介意，咱们依然是好朋友。无论如何，欢迎访问 thisamericanlife.org/lifepartners，使用优惠码 VIDEO 即可开启免费试用。链接也附在节目简介里了。

transcript.speaker: Ira Glass
transcript.en: Thanks as always to our program's co-founder, Mr. Torey Malatia. You know, this week, the place that he goes for acupuncture, they offered him a job. He told them, that's ridiculous. Why would I go work for the same organization that has stabbed me in the back? I'm Ira Glass, back next week with more stories of This American Life.
transcript.zh: 一如既往地感谢我们节目的联合创始人 Torey Malatia 先生。话说这周啊，他常去针灸的那家诊所竟然邀请他去那儿工作。他直接跟人家说：“这也太荒唐了，我干嘛要去一家在背后捅过我那么多刀（扎过我那么多针）的机构上班呢？”我是 Ira Glass，下周同一时间，我们继续为您带来更多《This American Life》的故事。
